events.title: live: new spells, first look
events.summary: we are playing rift raiders live on the store page. new spell effects, keepsakes that actually work now, and whatever goes wrong on stream. the demo is free to play right now. ask us anything in chat. Civan & Marcel

events.title: Spells Update
events.summary: the spells looked like orbs. now they look like spells. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46210268/503a04549b0a171799b1dfd9fa326fee2cceb0ca.gif here are the changes: a lot of keepsakes did nothing in the last build, fixed every spell has its own pixel effect now spell damage lands when the effect hits, not before steam deck pass, bigger text and deck button icons wall units have less hp, every unit moves at least 2 archers and artillery shoot one hex shorter elites drop a war chest of runebits gravemold crown:

events.title: live: rift raiders demo, come watch us die
events.summary: we are playing the demo live for next fest. come hang out, ask us anything, tell us what feels bad. the demo is free, try it while you watch. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46210268/736fd33b2647a29336aad0a1c59d2653da1ea7a8.gif

events.title: Next Fest Update: you asked, we fixed. game gooder now
events.summary: new demo build is up (main menu says demo.6 bottom left, gooder now) {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46210268/736fd33b2647a29336aad0a1c59d2653da1ea7a8.gif here are the changes: unit tooltips moved to holding right mouse, shift for the details new speed button in fights, 1x or 3x enemies you can hit stand on a red target hex end turn pulses when your unit has nothing left to do status effects show on the units now relics are keepsakes now, a lot more of them new units like the briarknife, plus new story event

events.title: demo.5: every biome rebuilt
events.summary: new demo build is up (main menu says demo.5 bottom left) here are the changes: every biome rebuilt by hand, the village is finally a village new units: skarnblade, tiderunner, knellringer, coffinwall and more new relics like last line ward and siegebreaker maul 10 new story events most faction spells reworked so they play differently hero select is a gallery now gamepad fixes and better text fit in all 15 languages thank you, we want this game to be a great experience for you, please leave feedb

events.title: the demo is out
events.summary: the demo is out, here is what you get one full rift run, ending in a boss play as morvek, the other five heroes stay locked draft a keepsake, then muster your units and a spell stack against stack fights on a hex grid story events, a shop and elite fights along the way extract early to bank your loot, or push your luck spend it at home to build up your kingdom kingdom upgrades stop at tier 2 in the demo 15 languages and full gamepad support thank you, we want this game to be a great experience f

events.title: Rift Raiders Playtest is open - join now
events.summary: WHAT THIS ISAn early playtest build. 0.1.0-playtest.2.Not a demo. Not a vertical slice. The loop, raw.Fight. Loot. Upgrade. Run again. WHAT YOU GETStack against stack tactical combat on the grid.Five elemental factions to recruit from. Fire, Water, Forest, Light, Dark.A rift full of branching nodes. Fights, elites, shops, events, bosses.A kingdom to rebuild between runs. 26 buildings.Spells that level up the more you cast them. WHAT YOU DON'T GETNo story. No lore. No hand holding.No achievements
